summary_1line: After Bhishma falls, warriors gather; Arjuna creates an arrow-pillow for him, and Bhishma resolves to lie on his bed of arrows until the sun’s northern course.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies suspended on a bed of arrows above the ground as Arjuna shoots three shafts beneath his head to form a pillow.
Both Kaurava and Pandava warriors lay down their arms and gather solemnly around the fallen Bhishma on the battlefield.
Arjuna, eyes filled with tears, draws the Gandiva and releases the arrows that lift the grandsire’s head.
